summary: ARES FORGE is a 3D roguelite survival game set on Mars (Jezero Crater) that turns real NASA mission engineering into fast, fun decisions for young learners. Players pilot an astronaut who must survive waves of hostile creatures while recovering 4 mission pieces, levelling up through upgrade cards that each carry a verified "REAL DATA" fact from NASA science (Perseverance, InSight, Curiosity, Ingenuity). Choices such as shield, power, weapons and suit upgrades teach resource and risk trade-offs behind a real Mars outpost. The game has five Martian zones with gameplay bonuses, meteors, NASA-inspired black hole events, three save profiles, English/Spanish, and adaptive controls and graphics for PC, mobile and console. It makes learning tangible: every upgrade is a trade-off, and every fact links to a NASA source.
details: ARES FORGE is a Roblox roguelite where the player survives on Mars. You recover 4 mission pieces in Jezero Crater while fighting waves, choosing upgrade cards (weapons, shield, suit, energy) and managing risk. Each card shows a REAL DATA fact checked against science.nasa.gov (Perseverance SHERLOC, InSight SEIS, Curiosity, Ingenuity). Five zones give bonuses; meteors and black hole events (Sagittarius A*, M87*, Cygnus X-1) add hazards. It makes space engineering trade-offs tangible and fun for students and sparks interest in Mars missions. Tools: Roblox Studio, Luau, Blender (generated meshes), Node.js NASA data layer, Remotion (trailer). Works on PC, mobile and console with adaptive quality, English and Spanish. Code, text and ideation were developed with SI assistance.
